records.title: Flame-Contaminated City
records.summary: After a disaster strikes Chaldea, a lone Master and Mash are sent to a burning Fuyuki in 2004, where a Holy Grail War is still underway. They must find out why the city was consumed by flames.

characters.name: Cú Chulainn (Caster)
characters.note: Temporary ally who guides the party through Fuyuki

characters.name: Altria Alter
characters.note: Darkened Saber guarding the Holy Grail

characters.name: Mash Kyrielight
characters.note: Demi-Servant who becomes the Master's partner

records.title: Hundred Years' War of the Evil Dragons
records.summary: Chaldea arrives in a France supposedly at peace shortly after Jeanne d'Arc's execution and finds it overrun by dragons and undead. The team gathers allies to resist the mysterious Dragon Witch.

characters.name: Jeanne d'Arc
characters.note: Holy Maiden of France who joins Chaldea

characters.name: Jeanne d'Arc (Alter)
characters.note: The Dragon Witch commanding the dragons

characters.name: Gilles de Rais
characters.note: Marshal of France serving the Dragon Witch

records.title: Eternal Madness Empire
records.summary: In the Roman Empire of 60 A.D., young Emperor Nero fights a rival Roman Empire formed by legendary Servants. Chaldea joins Nero's army to find the Holy Grail.

characters.name: Nero Claudius
characters.note: Living emperor who leads the resistance

characters.name: Boudica
characters.note: Warrior queen who aids Nero's army

characters.name: Spartacus
characters.note: Gladiator rebel who fights alongside Nero

records.title: Sealed Ends of the Four Seas
records.summary: Chaldea sails an endless, unstable ocean scattered with islands, meeting pirate captain Francis Drake who holds a powerful Holy Grail. The voyage involves pirates, legendary heroes, and rival claims to the Grail.

characters.name: Francis Drake
characters.note: Pirate captain who joins Chaldea's voyage

characters.name: Artemis & Orion
characters.note: Divine archer and her bear-plush companion

characters.name: Euryale
characters.note: Goddess who joins as an ally

characters.name: Medea Lily
characters.note: Young witch among the Argonauts' rivals

records.title: Death World in the Demonic Fog City
records.summary: A poisonous magical fog blankets Industrial Revolution London while Servants clash in the streets. Chaldea teams up with the city's local Servants to uncover who is behind it.

records.title: North American Myth War
records.summary: North America is split between a Celtic army and Edison's robot-backed Americans, with a resistance caught in between. Chaldea steps into the war to reach the Holy Grail.

characters.name: Thomas Edison
characters.note: Leads the American side with robot armies

characters.name: Geronimo
characters.note: Leads the resistance against both sides

records.title: Divine Realm of the Round Table
records.summary: In an impossible holy city in the Holy Land, a former legendary king rules over knights who admit only those she deems worthy. Chaldea navigates rival powers to reach the city.

characters.name: Bedivere
characters.note: Last knight who guides the party

characters.name: Ozymandias
characters.note: Desert god-king, first an obstacle then an ally

characters.name: Gawain
characters.note: Knight of the Round Table serving the Lion King

records.title: Absolute Demonic Front
records.summary: In ancient Mesopotamia during King Gilgamesh's reign, an alliance of three goddesses threatens Uruk and the cities around it. Chaldea aids Gilgamesh's coalition against the divine threat.

characters.name: Gilgamesh
characters.note: Wise King of Uruk, alive in this era

records.title: Grand Temple of Time
records.summary: After seven Singularities are repaired, Chaldea finds a final battleground that exists outside history. It must face the 72 Demon Gods guarding King Solomon's throne.

characters.name: Solomon
characters.note: Mage King holding the throne of time

characters.name: Lev Lainur Flauros
characters.note: Former Chaldea staff in service of the King of Magic

characters.name: Romani Archaman
characters.note: Chaldea's acting director and mission support

characters.name: Mash Kyrielight
characters.note: Stays at the Master's side to the end

records.title: Quarantined Territory of Malice
records.summary: Chaldea detects a Singularity in Shinjuku and sends its only Master to investigate. A magical barrier disrupts their arrival in a city under siege.

characters.name: James Moriarty
characters.note: Mastermind connected to the city's conflict

characters.name: Mash Kyrielight
characters.note: Supports the Master from Mission Control

records.title: Deep Sea Cyber-Paradise
records.summary: Chaldea receives an SOS from the oil platform Seraphix, and the Master is sent in through the AI BB. They end up in a digital world where Servants must fight one another to escape.

records.title: Subterranean World of Folklore
records.summary: People are vanishing across Central Asia, and several Chaldea Servants are pulled into a new Singularity. The Master investigates a giant hollow world beneath the earth.

records.title: The Stage of Carnage
records.summary: Ritsuka is pulled through a dream into a pocket world between dream and reality, where Heroic Spirit Swordmasters duel. The Master teams up with Miyamoto Musashi to deal with the threat.

characters.name: Miyamoto Musashi
characters.note: Living Hero who partners with the Master

characters.name: Amakusa Shirou Tokisada
characters.note: Swordmaster at the center of the conflict

records.title: The Forbidden Advent Garden
records.summary: A vast dark barrier cuts off Salem from the outside world, and the town resembles its 1692 past but something is wrong. Ritsuka's party enters disguised as a traveling troupe.

records.title: Permafrost Empire
records.summary: After human history is wiped out and split into seven Lostbelts, the last survivors of Chaldea cross a frozen world to reclaim it. The first Lostbelt is a Russia ruled by a snowbound empire.

characters.name: Anastasia
characters.note: Princess of Ice who joins Chaldea

characters.name: Ivan the Terrible
characters.note: Tsar who rules the Permafrost Empire

characters.name: Atalante
characters.note: Servant appearing on the official chapter page

records.title: The Eternal Icy Fire Century
records.summary: Chaldea seeks the Beldanders of the Wandering Sea to repair the Shadow Border and travels overland through a transformed Scandinavia. There humanity lives under the rule of the Jötunn.

characters.name: Scáthach-Skaði
characters.note: The Lostbelt's ruler, later aids Chaldea

characters.name: Napoleon
characters.note: Joins the party as comic relief

records.title: The Synchronized Intellect Nation
records.summary: Chaldea reaches a peaceful but stagnant empire where independent thought is a crime, after a poisoning forces the party to seek a cure. The ruler's worldview clashes with Chaldea's push for progress.

characters.name: Qin Shi Huang
characters.note: Ruler who calls himself the only true human

characters.name: Prince of Lan Ling
characters.note: Saber featured on the official chapter page

characters.name: Akuta Hinako
characters.note: Listed as the Crypter of this Lostbelt

records.title: Samsara of Genesis and Terminus
records.summary: Chaldea travels to India to upgrade the Shadow Border and finds a land whose people pray daily under a god. The world is caught in an endless cycle of rebirth meant to purge evil.

characters.name: Karna
characters.note: Hero of Indian myth who aids Chaldea

characters.name: Rama
characters.note: Hero of Indian myth who aids Chaldea

characters.name: Aśvatthāman
characters.note: Archer shown on the official chapter page

records.title: Ancient Ocean of the Dreadnought Gods
records.summary: Chaldea assaults the Greek Lostbelt as Kirschtaria Wodime's forces wait at the entrance, and the Nautilus is lost early. The survivors regroup and push through the Atlantis seas toward Olympus.

characters.name: Super Orion
characters.note: Grand Archer whose true strength emerges here

characters.name: Jason
characters.note: Captain of the Argonauts, leads the new crew

records.title: Interstellar Mountainous City
records.summary: Chaldea reaches the floating city of Olympus, built as the throne of the superior deities. It joins the God Destroyer Alliance in the final confrontation between humanity and the gods.

characters.name: Romulus-Quirinus
characters.note: Grand Lancer in the God Destroyer Alliance

characters.name: Orion
characters.note: Grand Archer in the God Destroyer Alliance

records.title: Naraka Mandala
records.summary: After returning from the Atlantic Lostbelt, Chaldea discovers an anomaly in Heian-kyo, a capital turned into a land of evil spirits. The city hosts a twisted Holy Grail War centered on Heroic Spirits.

characters.name: Ashiya Douman
characters.note: Rogue onmyoji tied to the ritual

characters.name: Taira no Kagekiyo
characters.note: Samurai spirit hunting the Heroic Spirits

records.title: Fae Round Table Domain
records.summary: Chaldea learns the British Lostbelt survived the destruction of its Tree of Emptiness and threatens to doom the planet. The team enters a fairy-ruled Britain and meets twisted Knights of the Round Table.

characters.name: Altria Caster
characters.note: The Avalon le Fae of the prophecy

records.title: Realm of the Thanatos Impulse
records.summary: Chaldea detects a massive Singularity with an immeasurable Humanity Foundation Value. The world is split into three realms, each ruled by a king, with Servants constantly summoned to fight one another.

records.title: Golden Sea of Trees Travelogue
records.summary: Chaldea sets out to take on the final Lostbelt and finds the surface a lifeless wasteland. The protagonist descends into an underworld beneath the former Amazon rainforest.

records.title: Zero Compass Inner Domain, Paper Moon
records.summary: Chaldea enters a world covered in strange light pouring from the Paper Moon. A system run by an AI rewards Servants for killing civilian AIs.

characters.name: Rani XII
characters.note: AI overseer who runs the system

characters.name: Bhīma
characters.note: New Servant featured in this chapter

characters.name: Duryodhana
characters.note: New Servant featured in this chapter

records.title: The Inescapable Gehenna, Id
records.summary: The second Ordeal Call continues the effort to correct a distortion with seven trials. Its theme centers on the Avenger class.

characters.name: Jeanne d'Arc (Alter)
characters.note: Receives a Rank Up Quest with this chapter

characters.name: Marie Antoinette (Alter)
characters.note: Featured in the chapter's pickup summon

characters.name: Taira no Kagekiyo
characters.note: Featured in the chapter's pickup summon

characters.name: Edmond Dantes (Monte Cristo)
characters.note: Featured in the chapter's pickup summon

records.title: Bellum Novae Humanitatis, Archetype Inception
records.summary: In a future city on the Moon without mortality or strife, Moon Cancers compete in a grand election for the world's highest honor. The protagonists must expose a cancer behind the schemes.

characters.name: Kishinami Hakuno
characters.note: New Servant obtained by clearing Part 3

records.title: Human Judgment Court, Trinity Metatronius
records.summary: The Ruler-class Servants of the Holy Grail War are the next distortion to be corrected, and Chaldea's abuse of them will be judged. The chapter unlocks after Ordeal Call II and III.

characters.name: Metatron Jeanne
characters.note: Limited-time 5-star Servant added with the chapter

characters.name: Dante Alighieri
characters.note: Joins the story summon after the chapter

records.title: The Special Chapter
records.summary: A special chapter placed after Ordeal Call IV. It closes Chapter II the way Solomon closes Chapter I.

staff.name: Marisbury Animusphere
staff.role: Founder and director of Chaldea (until his death)
staff.bio: Founded the Chaldea Security Organization and was father of Olga Marie Animusphere, who succeeded him as director. One wiki page gives his death year as 2012 and says he reportedly won the 2004 Fuyuki Holy Grail War, but sources fetched do not give circumstances or his wish, and Holmes can only speculate about his motives.

staff.name: Olga Marie Animusphere
staff.bio: Daughter of Marisbury, she inherited the post of director after his death. She is present at the start of Singularity F, and the wiki lists her status as presumed deceased with her true status unknown.

staff.name: Romani Archaman
staff.role: Head of Chaldea's medical division; acting director
staff.status: Deceased (traces of his presence remain in Lostbelt No.7)
staff.bio: Chaldea's doctor who provides support from the control room and takes over as director after Olga. He is listed as director from 2015 to 2016.

staff.name: Leonardo da Vinci
staff.role: Head of the Technology Development Division
staff.bio: A Caster-class Servant who leads Chaldea's technology development and later acts as its leader during the Epic of Remnant. She is listed as director in 2017.

staff.name: Mash Kyrielight
staff.bio: A Demi-Servant who fights alongside Ritsuka from Singularity F onward. She serves as Mission Control in some chapters, such as Shinjuku.

staff.name: Goredolf Musik
staff.role: Director and owner of Chaldea (from 2018 per wiki)
staff.bio: A Clock Tower magus who took over Chaldea after Olga's death and bought the organization after the Remnant Order. He was poisoned during Lostbelt No.3 and recovered with an antidote.

staff.name: Sherlock Holmes
staff.bio: A detective Servant contracted to Ritsuka who advises from the Atlas Institute. He analyzes Marisbury's 2004 Fuyuki Holy Grail War and cannot rule out that Marisbury was manipulated.

staff.name: Ritsuka Fujimaru
staff.bio: An untrained civilian Master candidate thrust into Fuyuki after the explosion at Chaldea. Becomes the organization's Master for the Grand Orders.

staff.name: Kirschtaria Wodime
staff.bio: A former Clock Tower Astromancy Department member who was an A-Team Master candidate and later defected. He appears as the Crypter of Lostbelt No.5 and leads the forces opposing Chaldea.

staff.name: Daybit Sem Void
staff.role: A-Team Master candidate; the last Crypter
staff.bio: A-Team Master candidate who defected from Chaldea. He appears as the last Crypter in Lostbelt No.7.
